feature_set_a_monthly_impressions.description: Raw impressions by channel, monthly (in millions)
feature_set_a_monthly_impressions.coverage: 52/36 months have data (14% of model period)
feature_set_a_monthly_impressions.implementation: Monthly sum of impressions_reel per channel, scaled by 1/1M
feature_set_a_monthly_impressions.model_usage: Apply same adstock and saturation as spend; compare coefficients
feature_set_a_monthly_impressions.expected_impact: HIGH - separates media volume from cost; r(spend,impressions) = 0.58-0.82

feature_set_b_cost_per_click.description: Engagement efficiency: cost to generate one click (digital channels only)
feature_set_b_cost_per_click.missing_data_handling: Rolling 3-month median CPC when current month has 0 clicks
feature_set_b_cost_per_click.expected_impact: MEDIUM-HIGH - diagnoses engagement quality; complements spend

feature_set_c_cpm_index.description: Cost efficiency index: current CPM / channel median CPM (normalized)

interpretation.0.8: 20% cheaper than channel average (good rate negotiation)

feature_set_c_cpm_index.expected_impact: MEDIUM - reveals seasonal rate negotiation success

feature_set_d_ctr.description: Click-through rate for digital channels (clicks / impressions %)
feature_set_d_ctr.note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - not correlated with sales; use for creative quality assessment

feature_set_e_media_composition.description: Media budget composition as % of total spend
feature_set_e_media_composition.rationale: Client constraint #1: structural media mix evolution (traditional→digital shift)
feature_set_e_media_composition.trend: FY2023: 45% trad / 55% digital → FY2025: 35% trad / 65% digital

step_5_rerun_model.comparison: Compare R², coefficients, ROAS with baseline

strengths: GRP data for traditional media (142 radio placements)
limitations: Single province weather proxy for 42 stores
recommended_mitigations: Use GRP↔impressions conversion for TV (formula: GRP = CPM basis)
Create TV impressions estimate from GRP if needed
Document data sparseness in model caveats
